entries.irish: Tá tú fiú.
Dealraíonn sé go bhfuil tú fiú.
Is féidir liom do chuid scileanna a fheiceáil.
An sinsear aoibh gháire ar tú.
Roghnaigh na Valkyries go maith.
Ar deireadh fada.
Anois is féidir liom a chuid eile.
A cath throid go maith.
Téigh anois, lenár blessing.

entries.english: You fight for all of us now.
entries.irish: Troid tú do gach duine againn anois.

entries.english: We shall watch your progress with interest.
entries.irish: Déanfaimid féachaint ar do dhul chun cinn le hús.
Tá tú cruthaithe duit féin.
Tá tú in ann go deimhin.
Bhuel throid, laoch.
A curadh fíor.
Tá tú i ndán do bua.
A cath fiú go deimhin.
Tá sé ina onóir.
Tá tú ag troid go maith.
Tá tú laoch mighty.

entries.english: Let us see what you are capable of!
entries.irish: Lig dúinn a fheiceáil cad tá tú in ann!
Iarrtar ort dúshlán a thabhairt dom?

entries.english: Now this I have been waiting for!
entries.irish: Anois seo tá mé ag fanacht!
An comhrac dom ansin!
Cruthaigh d'fhéadfadh!

entries.english: Is it blood that you are after?
entries.irish: An bhfuil sé fola go bhfuil tú tar éis?
Chun bua!
Tar ar ansin!

entries.english: Is it a fight you crave?
entries.irish: An bhfuil sé troid crave tú?
Ag seo caite!
Beidh muid ag duel?

entries.english: Show me what you can do!
entries.irish: Taispeáin dom cad is féidir leat a dhéanamh!

entries.english: Do not be shy, fight me!
entries.irish: Ná bheith cúthail, troid dom!
Cruthaigh tú féin!
An bhfuil tú fiú?

entries.english: Let us see if you are worthy!
entries.irish: Lig dúinn a fheiceáil má tá tú fiú!

entries.english: Do you think you can defeat me?
entries.irish: An gceapann tú gur féidir leat a defeat dom?
Bealtaine an bua laoch is fearr!

entries.english: Shall we see who is the strongest?
entries.irish: Feicfidh muid cé hé an láidre?
Ar deireadh thiar, dúshlán!

entries.english: Is that the best you can do?
entries.irish: An é sin an chuid is fearr is féidir leat a dhéanamh?
An bhfuil sé seo jest?
An bhfuil go léir agat?
Cad eile is féidir leat a dhéanamh?
Anois tá sé seo troid!

entries.english: Let the blood stain the ground!
entries.irish: Lig an fhuil stain an talamh!
Cruthaigh tú féin ansin! An bhfuil sé!
Stailc le gach d'fhéadfadh!

entries.english: I have seen mice more ferocious than you!
entries.irish: Feicthe agam lucha níos ferocious ná tú!

entries.english: An old spoon could hit harder than you!
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh sean spúnóg bhuail níos deacra ná tú!

entries.english: What a puny excuse for a champion!
entries.irish: Cad leithscéal puny do curadh!
Tar ar! An comhrac dom ansin!

entries.english: Are you all they could muster?
entries.irish: An bhfuil tú go léir a d'fhéadfadh siad muster?

entries.english: They truly let anyone pick up a weapon these days!
entries.irish: Lig siad go fírinneach duine ar bith a phiocadh suas arm na laethanta!
Ná humiliate do sinsear!
D'fhéadfadh leanbh troid níos fearr!

entries.english: Are you truly even a viking?
entries.irish: An bhfuil tú go fírinneach fiú inmharthana?

entries.english: Come now, surely that is not all?
entries.irish: Tar anois, surely nach bhfuil go léir?
Pathetic! Arís!
Iarrann tú an troid seo?

entries.english: And you call yourself a champion?
entries.irish: Agus tú ag glaoch tú féin le curadh?

entries.english: Did no one ever teach you proper footwork?
entries.irish: An raibh aon duine riamh a mhúineadh tú footwork ceart?

entries.english: You can do better than that!
entries.irish: Is féidir leat a dhéanamh níos fearr ná sin!

entries.english: Is that truly the weapon you will bring to this fight?
entries.irish: An bhfuil go fírinneach an t-arm a bheidh tú a thabhairt chun an troid?

entries.english: A greyling has more finesse than you!
entries.irish: Tá grayling níos mó finesse ná tú!

entries.english: Did the Valkyries make a mistake with you?
entries.irish: An ndearna na Valkyries botún leat?
Ná shealbhú ar ais!
Ní mór curadh a bhaint amach fíor!

entries.english: This is no place for weakness!
entries.irish: Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil.

entries.english: Long have I waited for this!
entries.irish: Fada tar éis fanacht liom seo!

entries.english: Do you wish for me to slay you?
entries.irish: Ar mhaith leat dom a slay tú?

entries.english: I know you must be better than this!
entries.irish: Tá a fhios agam ní mór duit a bheith níos fearr ná seo!

entries.english: You have not come all this way for nothing!
entries.irish: Nach bhfuil tú teacht ar fad ar an mbealach seo le haghaidh rud ar bith!

entries.english: Surely this is not your full power?
entries.irish: Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil

entries.english: You must be one with your weapon!
entries.irish: Ní mór duit a bheith ar cheann le do arm!
An bhfuil go léir?

entries.english: You must be stronger than this!
entries.irish: Ní mór duit a bheith níos láidre ná seo!

entries.english: Are you supposed to be worthy?
entries.irish: An bhfuil tú ceaptha a bheith fiú?
Ná náire dúinn!
dearmad tú d'áit!
